name: stepper
behavior: Progress indicator, not an interactive composite (no APG widget pattern applies): ordered-list semantics (ol > li), aria-current="step" on the active step, per-step state (completed, error) conveyed as visually hidden text alongside the label; indicators and connectors are aria-hidden

parts.statesNote: pending: border outline with content-secondary numeral/dot; active: action fill with on-action content; completed: iconRole success in action color; error: iconRole error in status-critical

parts.note: line between consecutive indicators along the orientation axis, hidden after the last step. Salt's dotted connector style and density response are RECIPE (character) in the Salt adapter, not anatomy.

anatomyNotes: Per-step stage maps onto the closed state list: pending -> rest; active -> selected (+ aria-current=step); error -> invalid (status-critical recipe on indicator and label). 'completed' is NOT a new state: it is rest with the indicator resolving iconRole success — a recipe on the indicator part, so the state list stays closed. Salt's nested sub-steps and locked/inprogress stages are Salt character/scope and stay in the Salt adapter.
